newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria's BBAG pays 120 mln ATS for Craiova stake.
newsitem.headline: Austria's BBAG pays 120 mln ATS for Craiova stake.

text.p: Austrian beverage group BBAG said on Tuesday it would pay 120 million schillings to acquire a 47 percent stake in Craiova, Romania's number two brewery.
BBAG already has wide-ranging interests throughout eastern Europe and controls most of the Austrian beer market through its Brau Union subsidiary.
Following the acquisition, which is subject to regulatory clearance in Romania, annual production at Craiova would be raised to 600,000 hectolitres from 527,000 currently, BBAG said in a statement.

The deal would be executed through a capital increase which will raise Craiova's nominal share capital to 62 million schillings from 32.6 million, chief executive Johannes Brandl told a news briefing.
"Taking a stake in this brewery will enable BBAG to increase its share of this interesting growth market to about 10 percent," the group said.
BBAG already owns Hungarian breweries Sopron and Martfu, Starobrno in the Czech Republic and Arbema in Romania.
BBAG last month reported a 69 percent jump in 1996 pretax profit to 1.304 billion schillings on group sales of 10.17 billion schillings. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 53112 274
